rolesToAdd.description: Non-EBUS transbronchial aspiration needle used through a conventional bronchoscope.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Filter by gauge, sheath diameter, working length, and minimum working channel; confirm the current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Aspiration needle intended for a named electromagnetic or catheter-navigation workflow.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the needle to the navigation platform, catheter or guide, working length, channel size, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Biopsy or aspiration needle intended for a named robotic bronchoscopy platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the needle to the robotic platform, bronchoscope or catheter, working length, channel size, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Capital platform used to navigate and control a robotic bronchoscopy system.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Treat as installed capital equipment; match all scopes, catheters, kits, and accessories to the exact platform generation and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Reusable, reprocessed, or single-use bronchoscope designed for a named robotic bronchoscopy platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the bronchoscope to the exact robotic platform generation and compatible procedure kit, accessories, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Catheter, guide sheath, or scope guide used to direct peripheral bronchoscopy sampling tools.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the guide to the bronchoscope channel, navigation platform, working length, compatible tools, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Sensor, electromagnetic patch, or related localization accessory for a navigation platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the sensor or patch to the exact platform generation, procedure configuration, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Single-procedure kit containing platform-specific navigation accessories.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the kit to the exact navigation platform, catheter workflow, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Controller, cart, field generator, connector, mount, bracket, or other accessory for a named navigation or robotic platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the accessory to the exact platform and generation; do not treat capital components as disposable catheter guides.

rolesToAdd.description: Adapter used to connect a bronchoscope to a named navigation platform or catheter workflow.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the adapter to the bronchoscope model, navigation platform, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Single-procedure introducer or accessory kit for a named robotic bronchoscopy platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the kit to the exact robotic platform, bronchoscope or catheter, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Biopsy forceps designed to use electrosurgical energy rather than function as ordinary cold forceps.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm bronchoscope channel fit and compatibility with the selected energy platform, accessories, settings, airway-fire precautions, and current IFU.

rolesToAdd.description: Dressings, securement devices, sutures, labels, and related post-procedure site-care materials.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Use the organization-specific dressing and securement standard for the access site or indwelling device.
